test: Compute R-410A equipment stock on hand at cut-off (running sum of WMS movements x master cost) by SKU and branch; compare to 2025 R-410A unit sales rate (months of supply), overall and by SKU/branch; trace R-410A stock PO receipts by year/quarter vs sales; check margin by year and by month in 2025, and whether remaining units still sell in late 2025.
support: Months of supply > 12 at the 2025 rate; stock concentrated in SKUs/branches with falling sales or no recent sales; stock POs for R-410A continued arriving into 2025 after sales fell; 2025 margin keeps falling into Q4.
weaken: Stock covers only a few months of 2025 sales; R-410A stock POs stopped early; remaining SKUs sell steadily each month; the margin collapse is a recording artefact (static cost) rather than markdowns.
expect: Moderately confident (60%) that months of supply exceed 12 for a sizeable part of the stock, but suspicious that the opening-balance/static-cost mechanics or a scheduled PO generator may make stock look larger than real; also expect the margin drop to be price-driven since cost is static.
